description.en: TSAI-MetaFraud is a multimodal, multi-task benchmark dataset for fraud detection in virtual economies, integrating behavioral, transactional, and graph-structured data. It defines tasks including fraud detection, node classification, temporal link prediction, and weakly supervised fraud detection, with baseline evaluations.
